-- TYPE MISMATCH ------------------------------------ main.fango

(/) needs:

    Float

but this operand is:

    Int

4| average values = List.foldl (+) 0 values / List.length values
                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

(/) works only on `Float`, and an `Int` does not convert by itself. Convert with
`Basics.fromInt`, or divide integers with `Basics.quotientBy`.

-- TYPE MISMATCH ------------------------------------ main.fango

The annotation for `average` says it returns:

    Int

but its body returns:

    Float

4| average values = List.foldl (+) 0 values / List.length values
                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
